/* 
搜索时可用 @@标签 的格式用标签搜索书籍 需要关闭精准搜索
可在 搜索地址 修改 separator 的值为你觉得输入方便的字符，默认为 @@ 。

n.exploreUrl:
<js>
let formatUrl = (url, category_index, order, time_type) => {
  return `{{ URL("/bookcity/${url}", {
"category_index": "${category_index}",
"count": "10",
"page": page - 1,
"order": "${order}",
"time_type": "${time_type}"
}) }}`
}

let push = (title, url, basis) => {
  list.push({
    title: title,
    url: url,
    style: {
      layout_flexGrow: 1,
      layout_flexBasisPercent: basis
    }
  });
};
let list = [];
let order_list = {
  "fans_value": "畅销",
  "no_vip_click": "点击",
  "yp": "月票",
  "word_count": "更新",
  //"track_read": "追读",
  "complet": "完结",
  "blade": "催更",
  "yp_new": "新书",
  "recommend": "推荐",
  //"tsukkomi": "吐槽",
  "favor": "收藏"
};
let time_type_list = {
  "total": "总榜",
  "month": "月榜",
  "week": "周榜"
};

let url = URL("/bookcity/get_category_list");
let response = decrypt(java.ajax(url)).data;
let category_list = response.category_list;
let tag_list = response.tag_list;

for (let timeTypeKey in time_type_list) {
  push(`【 ${time_type_list[timeTypeKey]} 】`, "", 1);
  for (let orderKey in order_list) {
    push(order_list[orderKey], formatUrl("get_rank_book_list", 0, orderKey, timeTypeKey), 0.29);
  }
}
push(`【 分类 】`, "", 1);
for (let item of category_list) {
  let category_index = item.category_index;
  let category_name = item.category_name;
  push(category_name, formatUrl("get_filter_search_book_list", category_index, "", ""), 0.29);
}

push(`【 标签 】`, "", 1);
for (let item of tag_list) {
  let tag_module = item.tag_module;
  let tag_name = item.tag_name;
  push(`${tag_name}`, `{{ URL("/bookcity/get_filter_search_book_list", {
"category_index": "0",
"count": "10",
"page": page - 1,
"${tag_module ? 'tag_module' : 'tag'}": "${tag_module ? tag_module : tag_name}",
}) }}`, 0.29);
}

JSON.stringify(list);
</js>

ruleBookInfo.author: author
ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
let bookid = java.hexDecodeToString(result)

baseUrl = URL("/book/get_info_by_id", {
  book_id: bookid
});
let $ = decrypt(java.ajax(baseUrl)).data.book_info;

let name = $.book_name;
let author = $.author_name;
let kind = [
  $.category_name,
  $.up_status == '0' ? '连载中' : '已完结',
  $.is_paid == '0' ? 'FREE' : 'VIP'
];
let wordCount = $.total_word_count;
let lastChapter = $.last_chapter_info.chapter_title;
let lastChapterTime = $.last_chapter_info.uptime;
let coverUrl = $.cover;
let tocUrl = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(bookid)},{"type":"Text"}`;
let formatNum = (num) => {
  return +num < 10000 ? num : (+num / 10000).toFixed(1) + "万";
};
let tags = $.tag;
let description = $.description;
let intro = ` 更新日期：${lastChapterTime}
点击：${formatNum($.total_click)}　收藏：${$.total_favor}　月票：${$.total_yp}　推荐票：${$.total_recommend}　打赏：${formatNum($.reward_amount)}　催更：${$.total_blade}
标签：${tags}
简介：${description}`;

result = {
  name: name,
  author: author,
  kind: kind,
  wordCount: wordCount,
  lastChapter: lastChapter,
  intro: intro,
  coverUrl: coverUrl,
  tocUrl: tocUrl
};
JSON.stringify(result);
</js>
